About Asmitha Paper Agency

Asmitha Paper Agency is a specialized B2B bulk paper and poly roll supplier based in Tiruppur. We support apparel manufacturing units, CAD/CAM pattern makers, textile processors, and industrial packaging businesses with consistent, high-grade paper rolls.

From 80–100 GSM kraft and white underlay rolls for fabric spreading to 220–400 GSM pattern rolls and auto-cutter HM poly rolls, we supply exact technical grades matched to your production floor workflows.
